welcome.intro: Welcome to Typelite. Press a shortcut, speak, and polished text lands wherever you type. First, allow the three things Typelite needs.

permissions.microphoneDesc: Hear your voice while you hold or tap a shortcut.
permissions.accessibilityDesc: Global shortcuts and typing into other apps.
permissions.automationDesc: Control System Events to paste and to see which app is in front.

microphone.intro: Pick the microphone Typelite should use. Speak and watch the meter move.

shortcut.label: Shortcut
shortcut.hint: Click the field, then press the keys you want to use.

dictation.intro: Dictate turns speech into clean text in the app you are using.
dictation.practice: Press {{key}}, say a sentence, then press {{key}} again. The text appears below.
dictation.practiceHold: Hold {{key}}, say a sentence, then let go. The text appears below.

translate.intro: Translate writes what you say in another language.
translate.practice: Press {{key}}, say a sentence, then press {{key}} again. The translation appears below.
translate.practiceHold: Hold {{key}}, say a sentence, then let go. The translation appears below.

ask.intro: Ask anything answers a spoken question.
ask.practice: Press {{key}}, ask a question out loud, then press {{key}} again.

practice.label: Try it
practice.placeholder: Click here, then use your shortcut…
practice.failed: That did not work ({{error}}). Try again.
practice.pasteFailed: The text could not be pasted

exercises.speak: Press {{key}}, read the line below, then press {{key}} again.
exercises.speakHold: Hold {{key}}, read the line below, then let go.
exercises.miss: That doesn't look like the expected result yet. Try again, or skip this exercise.
exercises.sameLanguage: You are translating into {{language}}, the language of this line. Read it in another language you speak, or pick another language above, to see a real translation.
exercises.switchHint: You chose {{count}} languages. While recording, press {{key}} to switch to the next one; the pill shows which one is active.

correction.title: Change of mind
correction.script: Let's have lunch at 1… oh no, let's do it at 2.
correction.caption: Typelite kept only your correction.

fillers.title: Fillers
fillers.script: Um, so, I think we should, like, ship it on Friday.
fillers.caption: Fillers like um and like are removed.

speakTranslate.title: Speak and translate
speakTranslate.script: Good morning, can we meet tomorrow afternoon?
speakTranslate.caption: Typelite wrote it in {{language}}.

selectionTranslate.title: Highlight and translate
selectionTranslate.instruction: Keep the text in the box selected (select it again if you clicked away). Press {{key}}, then press {{key}} again without speaking.
selectionTranslate.instructionHold: Keep the text in the box selected (select it again if you clicked away). Hold {{key}} for a moment without speaking, then let go.
selectionTranslate.caption: The selection was replaced by its {{language}} translation.

question.title: Ask a question
question.instruction: Press {{key}}, ask the question below out loud, then press {{key}} again. The answer opens in the Ask panel.
question.instructionHold: Press {{key}}, ask the question below out loud, then press {{key}} again. The answer opens in the Ask panel.
question.script: What is fifteen percent of two hundred forty?
question.caption: Typelite answered your question (the exact answer is 36).

edit.title: Edit a selection
edit.instruction: Keep the text in the box selected (select it again if you clicked away). Press {{key}}, say the line below, then press {{key}} again.
edit.instructionHold: Keep the text in the box selected (select it again if you clicked away). Press {{key}}, say the line below, then press {{key}} again.
edit.prefill: Hey, just checking whether you had a chance to look at the draft I sent over last week, no rush at all.
edit.caption: Typelite wrote a shorter version of your selection.
